source: make a 3D pet simulator games called pet hatches there's a clan working system you can make a fully working plan system a fully working pet system and hatch eggs from the actual ground kind of underground and floating from the ground in each stone and you can make prices for the zones make them reasonable and make the huge pets you can hatch from the eggs of the auto hatch

image_prompt.text: The central bazaar of egg stands, pet upgrades and zone purchases that every player keeps coming back to
Priced walls blocking each higher-tier zone, animating away when a player buys in
Walkable circulation chaining the hub out to every hatching zone and pet area
Glowing stones set into the ground with eggs embedded in them and more eggs hovering just above the surface, spread through each zone
Huge pets hatched from the eggs, shown at scale in open areas of each zone

notes: The prompt says eggs hatch from the ground kind of underground. If there is a real layer beneath the surface map the shape becomes world-underground and the route jumps to P2 + P3; it was read as eggs set into the surface instead, which stays P0.
Zone prices, the clan system, the pet system and auto hatch are all systems with no spatial footprint - the layout only carries the gates and zones they act on.

open_questions.ask: Is there an actual underground level players walk down into, or are the eggs just set into the ground on the surface? This changes the build route substantially.

How many zones are there, and roughly how big is each one?

answers.ask: Is there an actual underground level players walk down into, or are the eggs just set into the ground on the surface? This changes the build route substantially.
answers.answer: The eggs are set into and slightly floating above stone spots on the surface; do not make a separate underground level.

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the zones read as bright and cartoon, or something else?
answers.answer: Use a bright, colorful cartoon pet-simulator style.

answers.ask: How many zones are there, and roughly how big is each one?
answers.answer: Make 3 small connected zones, each roughly a compact play area with room for its egg stones, pets, and a zone gate with a reasonable price.
